answer_1_touched_vs_gap_through.question: Does touched-fill versus gap-through behavior support any descriptive difference?
answer_1_touched_vs_gap_through.comparison_domain: FILL anchor only; horizons 1/3/5 lawful native closes after the fill boundary tick; direction-adjusted p50 in bps; paired comparison made ONLY where both cells are predeclared DESCRIPTIVE_ADEQUATE.

direct_observations.reading: No difference in the body: h1 adj medians 0.0000 vs +0.0217 with near-identical IQR widths (1.714 vs 1.750 bps); the sign of the difference flips across horizons (h1 gap below touched, h3/h5 gap above); gap-through carries a heavier right tail (h3 p95 +25.50 vs +5.98 bps).

Gap-through adj medians are larger than touched at ALL THREE horizons (h1 +0.889 vs +0.030, h3 +1.370 vs +0.108, h5 +0.801 vs +0.161) with a ~2.3x wider h1 IQR (6.005 vs 2.620 bps) and |median| = 14.8% of h1 IQR width vs 1.1% for touched. Caveats carried: n=213 (bearish arm only 94), heavier tails (h1 p95 +15.14 vs +5.14), and raw-vs-adjusted sign divergence at h5 (raw p50 -0.2248 vs adjusted +0.8009).

interpretation.text: At the only two paired-eligible strata: 15s shows NO descriptive touched-vs-gap-through difference in the distribution body (difference sign not consistent across horizons, |differences| <= 0.105 bps against IQR widths ~1.7-5.2 bps); 30s shows a single-stratum contrast (gap-through adj medians higher at all three horizons, wider dispersion) that is descriptively visible but small-N and sign-sensitive to the direction adjustment at h5. There is therefore NO scale-consistent descriptive difference; the 30s contrast is registered as new descriptive information, not a finding.

Refines QG2 of the P-04 review: does gap-through fill (price reaching the far edge without a prior overlap touch) carry systematically stronger zone-direction post-fill drift than ordinary touch->fill, at strata with adequate N, under a drift-aware null? The 30s cell (n=213) is the motivating observation; 15s (n=682) is the natural replication stratum.

cells_excluded_from_comparison.1m: GAP_THROUGH n=81 DESCRIPTIVE_THIN - single-cell description only (adj p50 h1 0.0000, h3 -0.9421, h5 +2.4689 bps; raw h5 -2.1976), explicitly NOT compared.
cells_excluded_from_comparison.4h: GAP_THROUGH n=0 EMPTY - nothing to compare.

answer_1_touched_vs_gap_through.verdict: A weak, single-stratum (30s, n=213) descriptive contrast exists; no scale-consistent difference; no comparison outside the two predeclared-eligible pairs; no trading conversion.

answer_2_eligible_strata.question: Which native strata have enough N for even descriptive comparison?
answer_2_eligible_strata.rule_provenance: Predeclared eligibility labels from E1B_FILL_STRATIFICATION.json:predeclared_support_rule (thresholds fixed before per-cell inspection; noted by the artifact and by the director's order). P-04 did not choose or re-derive the rule.
answer_2_eligible_strata.answer: Under the predeclared rule, only 15s (gap-through n=682) and 30s (n=213) support an eligible paired touched-vs-gap-through descriptive comparison. 1m (n=81) is DESCRIPTIVE_THIN: single-cell description only. 5m (20), 15m (10), 1h (4) are TOO_SPARSE_FOR_COMPARISON; 4h is EMPTY (n=0). Note also that the 4h TOUCHED_FILL cell itself is DESCRIPTIVE_THIN (n=141), reinforcing the small-N caution already carried for 4h in the P-04 review.
